description.zh:
部署类型。取值：

- **4**：公网/VPC实例

- **5**：VPC实例
description.en:
The deployment type. Valid values:

- **4**: instance that is accessible over the internet and a VPC

- **5**: instance that is accessible only over a VPC

description.zh:
磁盘容量。

取值范围，请参见[计费说明](~~84737~~)。
> 若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数。
description.en:
The disk capacity.

For more information about the value range, see [Billing](~~84737~~).

> This parameter is not required when you create a Serverless instance.

description.zh:
磁盘类型。取值：

- **0**：高效云盘

- **1**：SSD
> 若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数。
description.en:
The disk type. Valid values:

- **0**: ultra disk

- **1**: SSD

> This parameter is not required when you create a Serverless instance.

description.zh:
公网流量。

- 如果**DeployType**为**4**，则需填写。

- 取值范围，请参见[计费说明](~~84737~~)。

> 若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数。
description.en:
The Internet traffic.

- This parameter is required if you set **DeployType** to **4**.

- For more information about the value range, see [Billing](~~84737~~).

> This parameter is not required when you create a Serverless instance.

description.zh:
流量规格。

- 取值范围，请参见[计费说明](~~84737~~)。

> 若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数。
description.en:
The traffic specification.

- For more information about the value range, see [Billing](~~84737~~).

> This parameter is not required when you create a Serverless instance.

description.zh:
付费类型。取值：

- 1（默认）：预留实例后付费。
- 3：Serverless实例预留规格后付费+Serverless弹性伸缩后付费。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

- 1 (default): pay-as-you-go for reserved instances.

- 3: pay-as-you-go for reserved capacity and elastic scaling of Serverless instances.

description.zh:
购买分区数。

* 取值范围，请参见[计费说明](~~84737~~)。
> 若实例为Serverless实例，无需传该参数。
description.en:
The number of partitions.

- For more information about the value range, see [Billing](~~84737~~).

> This parameter is not required if the instance is a Serverless instance.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh:
资源组ID。

不设置时落在默认资源组里，可在资源组控制台查看资源组ID。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance is added to the default resource group. You can view the resource group ID in the Resource Group console.

description.zh: Serverless实例的相关设置。创建 Serverless 实例时必传。
description.en: The settings of the Serverless instance. This parameter is required when you create a Serverless instance.

description.zh:
规格类型。

当PaidType参数为1（预留实例后付费）时取值：

- normal：标准版（高写版）
- professional：专业版（高写版）
- professionalForHighRead：专业版（高读版）

当PaidType参数为3（Serverless实例预留规格后付费+Serverless弹性伸缩后付费）时取值：

- basic：Serverless基础版
- normal：Serverless标准版
- professional：Serverless专业版

以上规格类型的说明，请参见[计费说明](~~84737~~)。
description.en:
The edition of the instance.

If you set the PaidType parameter to 1 (pay-as-you-go for reserved instances), valid values are:

- normal: Standard Edition (High-write)

- professional: Professional Edition (High-write)

- professionalForHighRead: Professional Edition (High-read)

If you set the PaidType parameter to 3 (pay-as-you-go for reserved capacity and elastic scaling of Serverless instances), valid values are:

- basic: Serverless Basic Edition

- normal: Serverless Standard Edition

- professional: Serverless Professional Edition

For more information about these instance editions, see [Billing](~~84737~~).

description.zh:
资源的标签键。
- N为1~20。
- 如果为空，则匹配所有标签键。
- 最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en:
The tag key of the resource.

- The value of N can be from 1 to 20.

- If this parameter is left empty, all tag keys are matched.

- The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。
- N为1~20。
- 如果标签键为空，则必须为空。为空时，匹配所有标签值。
- 最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en:
The tag value of the resource.

- The value of N can be from 1 to 20.

- If the tag key is empty, this parameter must also be empty. If this parameter is empty, all tag values are matched.

- The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka create-post-pay-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-type 0 --disk-size 1500 --deploy-type 4 --eip-max 3 --partition-num 100 --paid-type 0 --spec-type professional --io-max-spec alikafka.hw.2xlarge --resource-group-id rg-ac000000000007q --tag Value=test Key=FinanceDept --serverless-config ReservedPublishCapacity=60 ReservedSubscribeCapacity=20 --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alikafka CreatePostPayInstance --region cn-hangzhou --DeployType 4 --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --EipMax 3 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-ac000000000007q' --SpecType professional --DiskType 0 --PartitionNum 100 --PaidType 0 --IoMaxSpec 'alikafka.hw.2xlarge' --Tag.1.Value test --DiskSize 1500 --ServerlessConfig '{"ReservedPublishCapacity":60,"ReservedSubscribeCapacity":20}' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
